headline: GTA 6 countdown: 3 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 3 Days Left | Since 2013 | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 3 days until GTA 6. GTA 6 is the first main Grand Theft Auto game since GTA 5 came out in 2013. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: Some of us finished school, college and a job while waiting.
description: GTA 6 countdown - 3 days to go. GTA 6 is the first main Grand Theft Auto game since GTA 5 came out in 2013. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Facts from Rockstar's announcements as summarised on Wikipedia.
